grammar_points.explanation: 也 is placed before the verb to mean 'also' or 'too'.

grammar_points.title: 有 (to have)
grammar_points.explanation: 有 expresses possession or existence. For negation, use 没有 (méiyǒu).
examples: 我有中国朋友。Wǒ yǒu Zhōngguó péngyou. (I have Chinese friends.)
我家有五口人。Wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén. (My family has five people.)

grammar_points.title: 几 questions (how many)
grammar_points.explanation: 几 asks about small quantities (typically under 10). The measure word must be included.
examples: 你家有几口人？Nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén? (How many people are in your family?)
你女儿几岁了？Nǐ nǚ'ér jǐ suì le? (How old is your daughter?)

grammar_points.title: 多 questions (how)
grammar_points.explanation: 多 asks 'how' before adjectives like 大 (old) and 高 (tall).
examples: 你多大了？Nǐ duō dà le? (How old are you?)

grammar_points.title: 会 (can/be able to)
grammar_points.explanation: 会 expresses learned skills or abilities (as opposed to 能 which expresses physical ability or permission).
